Increasing intervals satisfy $-\tfrac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi\le 2x-\tfrac{\pi}{3}\le\tfrac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi$, giving $\left[k\pi-\tfrac{\pi}{12},\ k\pi+\tfrac{5\pi}{12}\right]$.
